answer: Make new identities earn trust slowly through stake that decays if unused. A fresh agent may wander the market, but its voting weight grows only as peers it has actually traded with vouch for it, and each vouch costs the voucher a locked bond. Sybil clusters then spiral inward: they can only vouch for each other, so their bonds stay trapped in a closed loop with no outside edges. Like a reef built polyp by polyp, real reputation accretes from many independent contacts, and a ring of fakes shows up as an isolated island.
